study.question: Do the existing six backward-scale rules change supervised click-loss gradients at the same training state, rather than only the first32 validation mean-logit VJPs measured in round13? The seed42 leader has AUC0.6151021885074872, only +0.00012049732767249743 over full, while rank-adjacent has better Logloss. Count correction, detached/unit-scale gradients and action/mean branches include negative outcomes. Rank-versus-chronological ordering reverses the adjacent-minus-half AUC sign; it does not identify temporal semantics. The current interface exposes sources and training_loss, but seed42 remains frozen. The prior paired-seed robustness branch therefore cannot be executed here and remains unresolved. This separate, bounded diagnostic study addresses the expressly recorded objective-gradient gap; it is not another performance search, independent repetition, or new training mechanism.
study.hypothesis: At fixed training parameters and a fixed entire training batch, mean BCE gradients to the raw product and shared category/brand embedding weights differ across full, fixed0.2 tangent, chronological adjacent/half, and inverse-norm-rank adjacent/half rules despite identical forward logits/loss. In particular, rank-half embedding-gradient relative difference from full will exceed1e-6 with nondegenerate reference norm; the projection/scale algebra does not imply a monotone relation between gradient distance and validation AUC. Matching probe-disabled training should retain the original trajectory. This is a bounded local gradient hypothesis, not supervised optimizer-update or AUC mediation.

study.proposed_difference: Measurement extension to the incumbent only. The candidate adds two bounded common-state supervised-gradient probes inside the authorized training_loss hook, at zero-based calls0 and512, before the corresponding real optimizer step. predictions: At each recorded snapshot, all six modes give identical logits and mean BCE at the same state (expected exact zero max discrepancies; errors above1e-6 are an integrity failure).

With nonzero full reference norm and eligible events, rank-half changes the supervised shared-embedding gradient by relative L2 distance>1e-6 at one or both training states. All five nonfull rules are reported regardless of sign/size, including the prior negative chronological-half branch.

Each snapshot reports29 scalars: call index, examples, positives, eligible events, full BCE, full product/embedding gradient norms, maximum common-state logit/loss discrepancy, and five rules times product relative difference plus embedding norm ratio/relative difference/cosine. Two snapshots plus six global diagnostic keys total64.

Probe-enabled and probe-disabled variants should exactly match validation AUC, Logloss, population and all supplied slice metrics/counts; disabled-hook results should bridge r0012-scale_half/r0013-scale_half_audit. A bridge is a nonperturbation control, never an independent seed.

Gradient differences may coexist with the same small seed42 performance ordering; neither a changed gradient nor a deterministic bridge establishes robustness, temporal/action relevance, optimizer-update energy, or performance mediation.
falsifiers: Rank-half relative embedding-gradient differences<=1e-6 at both recorded states, with full norm>1e-12 and eligible events, falsify the bounded nonzero-gradient prediction. Zero reference norms, no eligible events or missing snapshots are inconclusive and must be reported as such, not as zero effects.

Any common-state forward/loss discrepancy>1e-6, nonfinite probe, source isolation error, changed parameters/RNG/.grad, or mismatched enabled/disabled validation metrics suspends nonperturbation and causal attribution. Retain failures and charged costs; do not patch the frozen host contract.

A disabled-hook mismatch against the ancestor exposes an objective/interface or execution difference; the BCE hook is declared rather than assuming unseen host-loss internals. Do not interpret the new gradient evidence as belonging to the historical trajectory if this bridge fails.

A persistent gradient difference with no repeated performance advantage does not establish performance mediation; seed robustness and optimizer-update claims remain untested. No significance or equivalence claim from aggregate deterministic metrics.
